summary: Construct FormData from a form using successful-controls and formdata-event semantics.

semantics.controls: successful form controls in HTML-defined order

caveats: Requires live HTML form state; do not duplicate DOM_FORMS ownership.

tests.name: form values
tests.input: const f=document.createElement('form'); const i=document.createElement('input'); i.name='x';i.value='y';f.append(i); console.log(new FormData(f).get('x'))

tests.name: disabled omitted
tests.input: const f=document.createElement('form'); const i=document.createElement('input'); i.name='x';i.value='y';i.disabled=true;f.append(i); console.log(new FormData(f).has('x'))
